parameters.name: BillingCycle
parameters.description: The billing cycle, in the YYYY-MM format.

parameters.name: IsHideZeroCharge
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to filter out a bill whose pretax gross amount is 0. By default, a bill whose pretax gross amount is 0 is not filtered out. Valid values:

*   true: filters out a bill whose pretax gross amount is 0.
*   false: does not filter out a bill whose pretax gross amount is 0.

parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 300.

parameters.name: SubscriptionType
parameters.description:
The billing method. Valid values:

*   Subscription
*   PayAsYouGo

This parameter must be used together with the ProductCode parameter.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the bill. Valid values:

*   SubscriptionOrder
*   PayAsYouGoBill
*   Refund
*   Adjustment

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi query-bill --billing-cycle 2018-07 --type SubscriptionOrder --product-code rds --product-type rds --subscription-type Subscription --is-hide-zero-charge true --page-num 1 --page-size 20 --bill-owner-id 123 --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun bssopenapi QueryBill --region cn-hangzhou --SubscriptionType Subscription --BillingCycle '2018-07' --Type SubscriptionOrder --PageNum 1 --PageSize 20 --ProductCode rds --IsHideZeroCharge true --ProductType rds --BillOwnerId 123
